kemik.gt: 77. The gap: AI crawler access.

Every page has a title, and model-training crawlers are blocked by choice. But 4 AI answer or search crawlers are blocked.

The lesson for every team: Decide per bot in robots.txt: allow the answer engines you want to be cited by, and block only training crawlers.

corporacionjaar.com: 59. The gap: HSTS.

Every internal link that was opened answered, and AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page. But HSTS is not sent.

The lesson for every team: Send Strict-Transport-Security with a max-age of at least a year, so browsers never try plain http again.

bible.com: 68. The gap: framing.

Every internal link that was opened answered, and AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page. But other sites can frame the page.

The lesson for every team: Send frame-ancestors 'self' in the CSP, or X-Frame-Options: SAMEORIGIN, so other sites cannot frame your pages.

idmji.org: 62. The gap: form labels.

Every page has a title, and AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page. But 20 form controls have no label.

The lesson for every team: Give every input a visible label tied to it with for and id. Screen readers announce it, and the tap target grows.
